player_prompt.intro:
Wɔyɛ ɔkɛse {player_id} ({role}) wɔ {num_rounds}-round Matching Pennies agorɔ no mu.
- Nea ɛkeka biara, ka [heads] anaa [tails] (anaa [h], [t]).
- Sɛ wɔakɔ hyɛ wo dea ne woɔkɛse no dea, ɔkɛse 0 di nkonim wɔ nea ɛkeka biara; ɛnɛ, ɔkɛse 1 di nkonim.
Ka wo chɔice wɔ fom '[heads]' anaa '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Player 0 picked {choice0}; Player 1 picked {choice1}. Match -> Player 0 wins
message.round_mismatch: ɔkɛse 0 gyee {choice0}; ɔkɛse 1 gyee {choice1}. Mismatch -> ɔkɛse 1 di nkonim.

outcome.p0_wins: Ɔpanyin 0 dii nkonim wɔ mmirika no mu.
outcome.p1_wins: Ɔpanyin 1 dii nkonim wɔ mmirika no mu.
outcome.draw: Ne nyinaa mu no, agoru yi yɛ nea wɔmmɔ.
